objects.name: Tor Updates DoS Defenses Again as Relay Attacks Continue
objects.description: Tor 0.4.9.17 patches several security issues, including one related to how built-in DoS protections deal with IPv6. The post Tor Updates DoS Defenses Again as Relay Attacks Continue appeared first on SecurityWeek .
